df4d45e3-5704-48d9-86a1-db844ae66b57.quote: Krix adds maximum health. Voracity restores a little health and gold on unit kills, while Cannibalism permanently adds health on takedowns and suits the highest assist count in the game. Regenerative Tissue is the alternative first minor, regenerating health after a stretch without hero damage, trading kill sustain for recovery between fights. Festering Wounds adds anti-heal on immobilizes, but four allies already carried an anti-heal item, so that slot is not needed here.

df4d45e3-5704-48d9-86a1-db844ae66b57.quote: The winning core is Fire Blossom, Raiment of Renewal and Tainted Charm, none of which Steel built. Tainted Charm's proximity anti-heal would cover Countess and Mourn, the two biggest enemy healers, but four allies already carried anti-heal. Raiment of Renewal adds health and tenacity against Beguile and Seismic Assault, at the cost of Flux Matrix's magical armor and damage amplification. With the most mitigation on the team, the current armor stack is a sound keep.
